source_audio_policy: CC0 1.0 recordings already approved and bundled by their material-owning providers
storage_policy: No WAV is duplicated in this provider. Logical source paths resolve to the existing owning provider or the shared content-addressed asset catalog.
selection_policy: Recordings are used for chaotic physical textures: cloth, body contact, wood, stone, metal, scraping, and latches. Air motion, weapon trajectories, smoke, flash, alerts, and reward tones remain procedural.
